hutsulska-sorochka-mek.title: Huculska koszula kobieca MEK.jpg
hutsulska-sorochka-mek.artist: Unknown authorUnknown author Photograph: Pracownia Fotograficzna Muzeum Etnograficznego im. Seweryna Udzieli w Krakowie
hutsulska-sorochka-mek.desc: A long women's linen shirt from the Hutsul region. A red fabric insert is placed on the shoulders. The sleeves are decorated with extensive red cross-stitch embroidery in geometric patterns. The stand-up collar and chest slit are also adorned with delicate embroidery. In the collection of the Ethnographic Museum in Krakow.
